comment: Owners withdrawn from routine work: both bounded search axes are spent and the owner still does not reproduce. Data for the check, not documentation -- it keeps a small number of owners out of the queue without putting a record of dead ends in front of every contributor. An entry is removed the moment its owner becomes exact. The opposite register is exact/provisional.json, which holds owners that DO match but whose source was written toward the bytes.

unmatchable.reason: Reconstruction is complete and correct: 636 of 636 calls, in order, through the right per-site veneers, every argument value matching the reference, all eleven branches modelled (six conditionals, three pool skips, two else-joins), and the three pointer dereferences and single global store written. `bl` counts agree exactly at 636. What differs is register allocation alone. The reference emits NO high-register move anywhere in the function; the candidate emits 124, because the 16.16 coordinate constants repeat three to four times each (0x00B80000, 0x01C80000, 0x00F00000) so cse unifies them and reload parks them in r8, r9, sl and fp. The candidate pushes four callee-saved registers where the reference pushes {r5, lr} and rebuilds each constant with movs+lsls at its use: 55 fewer lsls and 50 fewer movs against 124 extra mov. No spelling of identical integer constants reaches it. Both axes spent: shape_sweep reports the axis exhausted; overlay_mode_cohort --scope singles attempted 154 configurations, compiled 37, exact 0, including `gcse-off` (-fno-gcse), which was missing from the table until this owner exposed the gap and which is the pass that does the parking -- the best, old-agbcc, gains 194 bytes and still does not match. The most likely source-side cause was ruled out by measurement: the large constants were recovered from the reference independently of the candidate and the multisets are identical -- 16 distinct values, matching counts, including 0x00F00000 at six sites and 0x00E00000 at five. So the reference's own build saw the same repeated constants and chose to rebuild rather than park them, which leaves no false cse opportunity in the candidate to remove. Routing was considered and rejected: CALLEE_SAVED_R4_OVERLAY_SOURCES exists for library and soft-float objects that do not take the game's ABI, this owner is a scene script, and abi-standard-r4 gains 68 bytes of 4,948. A prefix probe locates the divergence precisely and shows it is growth, not structure: truncated to its first 11 calls the candidate's prologue is `push {r5, lr}`, matching the reference exactly. The twelfth call is the second use of 0x00B80000, and adding it takes the prologue to `push {r5, r6, lr}`; each further repeat adds another register until all four high registers are in use. So the allocator diverges as the function grows over inputs that are otherwise identical, and no prefix of the source can be written differently to prevent it.
